name: Grok
description: xAI's conversational AI assistant with real-time web access, deep X/Twitter integration, image generation via Aurora, and strong reasoning capabilities powered by the Grok model family.

writing-chat.summary: Grok provides a conversational chat interface with a distinctive personality, supporting multi-turn dialogue, various response styles, and integration with the X platform for context-aware conversations.

subFeatures.name: Conversational Chat
subFeatures.description: Multi-turn dialogue with Grok's characteristic direct and sometimes humorous communication style, adjustable between fun and professional modes

subFeatures.name: X/Twitter Context
subFeatures.description: Grok can reference and analyze X/Twitter posts, trends, and conversations as context in chat interactions

subFeatures.name: Think Mode
subFeatures.description: Extended reasoning mode where Grok shows its step-by-step thinking process for complex questions

subFeatures.name: DeepSearch
subFeatures.description: Multi-step web research that synthesizes information from multiple sources into comprehensive answers

limitations: Free tier has limited message allowance per time period
Personality style may not suit all professional contexts
Context window smaller than some competitors
Primarily available through X app and x.ai website

pricingTiers.details: Limited Grok access through X app with basic model
Grok access with standard message limits
Higher limits, Think mode, DeepSearch, priority access
Highest limits, all features, Grok 3 access

versionHistory.changes: Major reasoning upgrade, Think mode, DeepSearch, benchmark-leading performance
Improved reasoning, image understanding, coding capabilities
128K context window, improved coding and math
Initial release with real-time X data access

research.summary: Grok has strong research capabilities through real-time web access, X/Twitter trend analysis, and DeepSearch for multi-step autonomous research across the web.

subFeatures.name: Real-Time Web Search
subFeatures.description: Live web search integrated into conversations, providing current information with source citations

subFeatures.name: X/Twitter Trend Analysis
subFeatures.description: Analyze trending topics, sentiment, and conversations on X/Twitter in real time — a unique capability among AI assistants

subFeatures.name: DeepSearch
subFeatures.description: Autonomous multi-step research that browses dozens of sources, cross-references information, and produces detailed research reports

limitations: Web search results biased toward X/Twitter content
DeepSearch limited to higher-tier subscriptions
Cannot access paywalled academic or news content
Research depth varies by topic — strongest on technology and current events

pricingTiers.details: Basic web search with limited usage
Web search and X trend analysis

versionHistory.changes: Multi-step autonomous research with source synthesis
Real-time web and X data access from launch

file-analysis.summary: Grok can analyze uploaded images, documents, and files with multimodal understanding, including screenshots, charts, photographs, and text documents.

subFeatures.name: Image Analysis
subFeatures.description: Analyze uploaded images including photographs, screenshots, charts, and diagrams using Grok's vision capabilities

subFeatures.name: Document Reading
subFeatures.description: Read and extract information from uploaded text documents and PDFs

subFeatures.name: X Post Analysis
subFeatures.description: Analyze shared X/Twitter posts, threads, and associated media content

limitations: File upload types more limited than competitors
No spreadsheet or CSV analysis with code execution
No sandboxed code environment for data processing
Image analysis capabilities still improving

pricingTiers.details: Image and document analysis with higher limits
Full file analysis with maximum usage

versionHistory.changes: Multimodal image understanding added
PDF and document upload support

document-creation.summary: Grok generates text-based documents, reports, summaries, and formatted content through its chat interface. It can produce structured output including tables, lists, and formatted text.

subFeatures.name: Report Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate structured reports, summaries, and analysis documents from research queries and uploaded content

subFeatures.name: Formatted Text Output
subFeatures.description: Produce markdown-formatted content with headers, tables, code blocks, and structured lists

subFeatures.name: X/Twitter Content Creation
subFeatures.description: Draft posts, threads, and social media content optimized for the X platform

limitations: No dedicated document editor or workspace
No export to Word, PDF, or other document formats
No collaborative document editing
Cannot create presentations or slide decks

versionHistory.changes: Improved long-form document generation with better structure
Enhanced text generation quality and formatting

image-generation.summary: Grok integrates Aurora, xAI's image generation model, for creating images from text prompts directly within the chat interface, including photorealistic and artistic styles.

subFeatures.name: Aurora Image Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate high-quality images from text descriptions using xAI's Aurora model, supporting photorealistic, artistic, and abstract styles

subFeatures.name: Image Editing
subFeatures.description: Modify and iterate on generated images through conversational follow-up prompts

subFeatures.name: Fewer Content Restrictions
subFeatures.description: Aurora has notably fewer content restrictions compared to competitors like DALL-E, allowing a wider range of creative outputs

limitations: Image generation quality below DALL-E 3 and Midjourney for some styles
Generation limits based on subscription tier
No precise layout or composition controls
Text rendering in images less reliable than competitors

pricingTiers.details: Aurora image generation with daily limits
Higher generation limits and priority access

versionHistory.changes: Native image generation model integrated into Grok
Initial image generation via FLUX model partnership

prototyping.summary: Grok can generate code and assist with prototyping tasks through its chat interface, though it lacks a dedicated code execution environment or IDE integration.

subFeatures.name: Code Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate code in multiple programming languages from natural language descriptions, with syntax highlighting and explanations

subFeatures.name: Code Explanation and Debugging
subFeatures.description: Analyze, explain, and debug code snippets shared in conversation

limitations: No sandboxed code execution environment
No live preview or code runner
No IDE integration
Coding capabilities behind GPT-4o and Claude for complex tasks
Cannot execute or test generated code

versionHistory.changes: Significantly improved coding performance
Improved coding and mathematical reasoning

personalization.summary: Grok offers personality mode selection and leverages X profile context for personalized interactions, though it has fewer personalization options than competitors.

subFeatures.name: Personality Modes
subFeatures.description: Switch between 'Fun Mode' (witty, irreverent) and 'Regular Mode' (more straightforward) for different interaction styles

subFeatures.name: X Profile Context
subFeatures.description: Grok can use your X/Twitter profile, posts, and interests to provide contextually relevant responses

limitations: No custom instructions system like ChatGPT
Personalization limited to mode selection and X profile data
No persistent user preference system beyond X integration
Cannot create custom personas or specialized bots

pricingTiers.details: Personality modes with X profile integration

versionHistory.changes: Fun and Regular mode options at launch
Use X profile data for personalized responses

persistent-context.summary: Grok maintains conversation history within the X app and can reference prior conversations, though cross-session memory features are more limited than competitors.

subFeatures.name: Conversation History
subFeatures.description: Previous conversations saved and accessible within the Grok interface on X

subFeatures.name: X Activity Context
subFeatures.description: Grok has ambient awareness of your X/Twitter activity, providing a passive form of persistent context about your interests

limitations: No explicit memory system like ChatGPT's Memory feature
No custom knowledge base uploads
Conversation history management is basic
No cross-device session continuity beyond X app sync

pricingTiers.details: Full conversation history and X activity context

versionHistory.changes: Persistent conversation storage in X app
X/Twitter activity awareness from launch

agents.summary: Grok has emerging agentic capabilities through DeepSearch (autonomous research) and the xAI API for building custom agents, though it lacks the browser automation and task execution of competitors.

subFeatures.name: DeepSearch Agent
subFeatures.description: Autonomous multi-step research agent that browses the web and X/Twitter to compile comprehensive reports on any topic

subFeatures.name: xAI API for Custom Agents
subFeatures.description: Build custom agentic applications using the xAI API with function calling, tool use, and structured outputs

limitations: No browser automation or task execution agent
No Operator-like capability for web tasks
Custom agent building requires API access and development effort
DeepSearch limited to information gathering, not task execution

pricingTiers.details: Build custom agents with function calling

versionHistory.changes: Autonomous multi-step research agent
Tool use and function calling support in API

connectors.summary: Grok's primary connector is its deep integration with the X/Twitter platform. Beyond X, it connects through the xAI API for programmatic access.

subFeatures.name: X/Twitter Integration
subFeatures.description: Native deep integration with X — access posts, trends, user profiles, and conversations directly from the AI assistant

subFeatures.name: xAI API
subFeatures.description: RESTful API compatible with OpenAI SDK format, enabling integration with existing toolchains and applications

limitations: No third-party app integrations beyond X
No Google Drive, OneDrive, or cloud storage connectors
No plugin or extension ecosystem
No Slack, Notion, or productivity tool integrations
API is the only integration path for non-X services

pricingTiers.details: Programmatic access starting at $2/M input tokens for Grok 2

versionHistory.changes: Public API with OpenAI-compatible format
Deep X/Twitter platform integration at launch

dictation.summary: Grok supports voice input through the X mobile app, with voice conversations and speech-to-text for dictating prompts.

subFeatures.name: Voice Input on X App
subFeatures.description: Use voice to interact with Grok through the X mobile app, with speech-to-text transcription for prompts

subFeatures.name: Voice Conversations
subFeatures.description: Have spoken conversations with Grok using voice mode in the X app

limitations: Voice features only available in X mobile app
No web browser voice input
Voice conversation quality varies by device and connection
Limited voice customization options

pricingTiers.details: Full voice features with priority access

versionHistory.changes: Voice conversations added to Grok on X mobile app
